title: The Voice from Heaven
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever taken a step that felt small but changed everything that followed?
reflectionText: Jesus did not need to be baptized. He was not confessing sin. He was not starting over. But he stepped into the same river as everyone else and did the same thing they were doing — and in that ordinary act, a door opened and a name was spoken aloud. What is it to begin something not by doing a thing of great note, but by standing in the river alongside everyone, and saying yes alongside them?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
